name: Kickstarter iOS (arm64, zero-config)
description: https://github.com/kickstarter/ios-oss: an .xcodeproj with local Swift packages (KsApi, Library, ...), not seen while xcfs was developed; setup copies the repository's Secrets.swift.example as its Makefile does.

create: cd {dest} && mkdir -p Frameworks/native-secrets/ios && cp -n Configs/Secrets.swift.example Frameworks/native-secrets/ios/Secrets.swift && cp -n Configs/Secrets.swift.example KsApi/Sources/KsApi/Secrets.swift
plain.build: xcodebuild build -project Kickstarter.xcodeproj -scheme 'Kickstarter iOS' -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64

edits.name: edit a function body in the app target
edit a function body in a package ~800 files import (KsApi)
add a public declaration to that package
